wikitext: {{AnimeLocationInfobox |name=Orsay City |characters=オルセイルシティ |japanese=Orseille City |image=Orsay City.png |imagesize=300px |region=Kalos |epicode=M17 |episode=Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction }} '''Orsay City''' (Japanese: '''オルセイルシティ''' ''Orseille City'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kalos]]. It is one of the settings of ''[[M17|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction]]''. Notable landmarks are a Pokémon stadium, a large port, and a shopping mall. Just outside the city is a {{p|Rhyhorn}} racetrack. {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, and {{an|Diancie}} arrived in Orsay City by boat in their quest to search {{OBP|Xerneas|M17}}. Once in Orsay City, they immediately went to the city's shopping mall. {{an|Serena}} and {{an|Bonnie}} taught Diancie the pleasure of shopping there. However, during this, Diancie noticed her [[Carbink servants]] looking for her. They had to remind Diancie that she needed to search for Xerneas instead of enjoying herself. After escaping from them and getting outside the mall, Diancie explained the situation with her servants to Ash and his friends. Right at that moment, [[Merilyn]] and her {{p|Delphox}} attacked. The group left Orsay City to protect Diancie from the thieves. ==In the manga== [[File:Orsay City M17 manga.png|thumb|left|200px|Orsay City in ''{{ma|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction}}'']] ===Movie adaptations=== Orsay City appeared in ''{{ma|Diancie and the Cocoon of Destruction}}''. {{sectionstub}} {{-}} ==Trivia== ===Origin=== {{main|Pokémon world in relation to the real world#In the movies|Pokémon world in relation to the real world → In the movies}} Orsay City is based on {{wp|Toronto}}Location Scouting Report on the Pokémon movie website ([https://web.archive.org/web/20140625080318/http://www.pokemon-movie.jp/locahan_report/ archived]) (Japanese) ([https://dogasu.bulbagarden.net/movies/2014_xy_cocoon_destruction_diancie/xy_cocoon_destruction_diancie_location_scouting.html English translation by Dogasu]), the most populous city in Canada located by {{wp|Lake Ontario}} in the province of {{wp|Ontario}}. The local shopping mall is modeled after the {{wp|Toronto Eaton Centre}}, a shopping mall located in the downtown core of Toronto.
